### Segments of Solitude
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-24-2012.html
Passage: Psalm 62:5
Points:
- Waiting quietly before God is an oasis of personal transformation rather than a brief pit stop.
- True spiritual solitude strips away life's clutter and replaces inner anxiety with serenity.
- Secret struggles and unresolved personal battles are brought into the open before God.
- Prolonged stillness allows the Lord to examine our deep thoughts and expose what we hide.

### Finding True Rest Before the Rush of the Week Begins
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/finding-true-rest-before-the-rush-of-the-week-begins.html
Passage: Psalm 62:1-2
Points:
- Soul rest in God alone is a sacred requirement rather than an optional practice.
- Relying on personal energy while ignoring God's rhythm of rest leads directly to burnout.
- Believers must repent of putting God on the back burner in the name of busyness.
- Rest requires intentional scheduling so time in God's presence remains our top weekly priority.
- Pausing in God rekindles the joy of our salvation and lets us hear His quiet voice.
